f.n: Glacier Bay National Park & Preserve - Closed Waters A
f.d: National Park and Preserve - Closed Area
f.pu: To protect wildlife within Glacier Bay National Park.
f.re: It is unlawful to operate a vessel in these waters, or otherwise approach within 100 yards of these waters. Restrictions imposed are minimum distances. Park visitors are advised that protection of park wildlife may require that visitors maintain greater distances from wildlife.
f.ma: National Park Service

f.n: Glacier Bay National Park & Preserve - Closed Waters B
f.d: National Park and Preserve - Closed Area
f.pu: To protect wildlife within Glacier Bay National Park.
f.re: Operating a vessel in these waters is prohibited from May 1 through August 31. Restrictions imposed are minimum distances. Park visitors are advised that protection of park wildlife may require that visitors maintain greater distances from wildlife.
f.ma: National Park Service

f.n: Gwaii Haanas National Marine Conservation Area Reserve and Haida Heritage Site - Didxwahxyangs (Darwin Sound)
f.pu: The small strict protection zone in southern Didxwahxyangs (Darwin Sound) includes a unique sheltered area of high productivity.
f.re: The following activities are prohibited in the Strict Protection Zone: 1. commerical fishing/harvesting; 2. recreational fishing/harvesting; 3. shellfish aquaculture; 4. finfish aquaculture; 5. Gwaii Haanas operational floating accommodations; 6. Commercial floating accommodations.

f.n: Hecate Strait and Queen Charlotte Sound Glass Sponge Reefs Marine Protected Areas - Core Protection Zone
f.pu: To protect the area around the glass sponge reefs.
f.re: It is prohibited in the Marine Protected Areas to: 1. carry out any activity that disturbs, damages, destroys or removes any living marine organism or any part of its habitat or is likely to do so; or 2. carry out any scientific research or monitoring, or any educational activity, unless it is part of an activity plan that has been approved by the Minister.
f.rn: Hecate Strait and Queen Charlotte Sound Glass Sponge Reefs Marine Protected Areas Regulations (SOR/2017-15)
